private_profile.title: Private Profile
private_profile.info: Your profile will be inaccessible to other players. Nothing will be viewable with this configuration enabled. You can still view your profile, and display it publicly.

display_badges.title: Display Badges
display_badges.info: The `Badges` field will be removed from your profile. It will not be viewable by other players. You can still display it publicly, or view it privately.

display_wl_ratio.title: Display W/L Ratio
display_wl_ratio.info: Your W/L (Win / Loss) ratio will be viewable to other players. They'll be able to see how many battles you've won / lost, including a calculated ratio.
